procedure.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d) && HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm bin/swissknifeman doctor --json > $H/d.json; rc=$?; [ $rc -le 1 ] && python3 -c 'import json, sys; d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); units = {x["unit"] for x in d["results"]}; assert d["schema"] == "umbrella-doctor/v1" and {"aicore", "skiller", "maind", "harness", "brain", "orch", "analyst"} <= units, units; assert all(x["status"] in ("ok", "warn", "fail", "skip") for x in d["results"])' $H/d.json
